Subject: Summit: consolidated arrival windows + contingency routing

Hi all,

We have a tighter window for the Crestline Summit on May 10–12 in Austin. A couple of incoming flights are on different carriers and there are known weather risks on the East Coast the weekend before. Goal: make a short leg-recovery plan so we can land everyone at the hotel between 3–6pm local on May 10, with fallback transfer options if a PNR goes irregular.

Quick asks:
- Skyline: can you provide alternate routing for the three PNRs below (shortest re-route + standby options)?
- GroundOps: estimate shuttle capacity and an hourly arrival plan if flights land staggered across 90 minutes.
- Ben/Laura/Rishi: confirm who is allowed to be rebooked onto earlier/later legs and any preferences (e.g., seat/meal constraints).

Passenger keys (partial):
- CRE-1001: Emily Park / May 10, DL 412 / SFO→AUS / ETA 15:10
- CRE-1002: Marcus Lin / May 10, AA 842 / SFO→DFW→AUS / ETA 16:45
- CRE-1003: VP Team block (3 pax) / May 10, UA 220 / LAX→AUS / ETA 15:55

If you can turn around initial routing + short commentary by end of day Monday (May 3), we can finalize transfers and publish an arrival matrix to the attendees. Attaching the current passenger list.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Events & Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa / team,

Thanks — reviewed the three PNRs and pushed a couple of routing options into the PNR notes. High-level:
- CRE-1001 (Emily Park): DL 412 is showing potential 45–60min delay risk due to connecting crew constraints. Alternate: AA routing SFO→DFW→AUS (AA 120/AA 456) adds ~1h but has seat availability; standby also possible on DL 678 (earlier morning) if needed.
- CRE-1002 (Marcus Lin): current AA itinerary has long DFW connection; we can swap to nonstop SWA 309 if Marcus accepts travel on a different carrier (cost delta explained).
- CRE-1003 (VP block): we held immediate re-protect seats on UA 224 (later) and UA 216 (earlier); recommend keeping UA 220 but prepare ground transfer for the 16:00–17:30 window.

Actions we recommend:
1) Confirm who we can auto-rebook (Tessa / Laura to sign off).
2) Approve SkyLine to issue re-routing if a delay >45 minutes is published by the carrier.
3) Book two shuttle runs (15:30 and 17:00) with 45-person capacity and an on-call sedan for executive pick-ups.

I've added PNR-legs-summary.txt to the ticket notes and cc'ed GroundOps for the shuttle ask.

Best,
